target_year_over_year_context.explanation: The 2023 disclosure covers the assumption of VMware equity awards for continuing employees and the acceleration/conversion of non-employee director awards. The 2024 filings split this topic: D071 covers the assumption/conversion of employee RSU/PSU awards (and director acceleration), while D126 specifically details the assumption of awards under the 2007 Plan and the conversion into 46 million Broadcom RSUs for continuing employees. These two 2024 disclosures collectively cover the subject matter of the single 2023 disclosure regarding equity award assumption.

comparisons.peer_topic: RSU and PSU Grant Terms and Vesting
comparisons.peer_summary: The 2006 Plan authorizes RSUs and stock options, with PSUs granted to senior officers and employees vesting after three years and one month. Other RSU and option awards generally vest over four years, with 10 million PSUs outstanding as of December 28, 2024.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies disclose the structure and vesting terms of their performance stock unit (PSU) and restricted stock unit (RSU) awards as part of their employee equity incentive plans. While Broadcom's disclosure focuses on the specific assumption and conversion of VMware awards in the context of a merger, Intel details the standard grant terms for its own equity plans. Specifically, Intel states that PSUs are granted to senior officers and employees with a vesting period of three years and one month, whereas Broadcom describes converting VMware awards into Broadcom common stock RSUs for continuing employees, highlighting a difference in operational context (post-merger integration vs. standard annual granting) but the same instrument type (PSUs/RSUs) and beneficiary groups (employees/senior officers).

sentences.text: We assumed all outstanding VMware RSU awards and performance stock unit ("PSU") awards held by continuing employees.
The assumed awards were converted into RSU awards for shares of Broadcom common stock.
We grant RSUs with a service condition as well as RSUs with a market condition, performance condition, and a service condition, which we call PSUs.
PSUs are granted to a group of senior officers and employees.
